blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Preoperative liver-tumor assessment requires segmentation, physical-space measurement, visual evidence, and resection planning from the same three-dimensional CT volume. Existing tools often handle these steps separately, while language models cannot reliably compute physical measurements from CT. To provide an integrated workflow, we present VoxelSage, a multi-modal system for two- and three-dimensional visualization, liver-tumor analysis, and preoperative resection planning. Its dual-port architecture separates language-model orchestration from image computation: Port A interprets requests and selects skills, while Port B applies them to CT volumes and segmentation masks and returns structured results. Keeping physical measurements in Port B prevents the LLM from computing them directly and reduces the risk of fabricated numerical results. Eight built-in skills support quantitative analysis, visual evidence generation, three-dimensional reconstruction, segmentation refinement, and sequential resection planning; user-defined skills can extend these functions. For sequence planning, a behavior-cloned neural ranker orders candidate resection targets, while a simulator-based shield checks them against predefined constraints. Across 256 unseen simulator scenes, this approach reduced mean simulated time from 34.274 to 33.388 min (0.886 min, 2.59%) and mean simulated blood loss from 300.847 to 183.852 mL (116.995 mL, 38.89%) relative to a deterministic baseline. These results demonstrate system integration and simulator-level performance, not clinical efficacy or safety. The public implementation is available at https://github.com/ZJUMAI/VoxelSage .
blocks.zh: 手术前肝肿瘤评估需要分化,物理空间测量,视觉证据,以及从同一个三维CT体积进行分解规划. 现有工具往往分别处理这些步骤,而语言模型无法可靠地从CT计算物理测量. 为了提供综合工作流程,我们提出了VoxelSage,一种双维和三维可视化的多模式系统,肝肿瘤分析,以及手术前重新剖面规划. 它的双端口架构将语言-模型的管弦与图像计算分开: 端口 A解释请求和选择技能,而Port B将其应用于CT卷和分解口罩并返回结构化结果. 保持B港的物理测量使LLM无法直接计算,并降低了编造数字结果的风险. 8种内置技能支持定量分析,视觉证据生成,三维重建,分化精细,以及顺序分解规划;用户定义的技能可以扩展这些功能. 对于序列规划,一个行为克隆的神经分级器命令候选人重新剖析目标,而一个基于模拟器的屏蔽则根据预先定义的限制来检查它们. 这种方法将256个不可见模拟场景的平均模拟时间从34.274分钟减少到33.388分钟(0.886分钟,2.59%),将模拟失血时间从300.847分钟减少到183.852毫升(116.995毫升,38.89%)。 这些结果显示系统集成和模拟水平性能,而不是临床疗效或安全性. 公众执行情况见https://github.com/ZJUMAI/VoxelSage。

blocks.en: Preoperative liver-tumor assessment requires more than detecting tumors in CT. Information from the full CT volume must be combined to quantify tumor burden and assess vascular relationships, resection margins, and preserved liver tissue. For these findings to support resection planning, the CT volume, segmentation masks, measurements, and visual evidence must remain linked to the same case and physical coordinate system.
blocks.zh: 手术前肝肿瘤评估需要的不仅仅是检测CT中的肿瘤. 必须结合全部CT体积的信息,量化肿瘤负担,评估血管关系,重新剖析边距,保存肝脏组织. 为了支持重新分解规划,这些结论的CT体积、分解口罩、测量和视觉证据必须保持与同一案件和物理坐标系统的联系。

blocks.en: Existing methods address individual parts of this task. VISTA3D, TotalSegmentator, and BiomedParse provide automatic or prompt-guided medical-image segmentation ( He et al. 2025 ; Wasserthal et al. 2023 ; Zhao et al. 2025 ) ; CT-CLIP connects volumetric CT with text ( Hamamci et al. 2026 ) ; and CT-Agent and 3DMedAgent organize specialized tools and selected evidence for multi-step CT reasoning ( Mao et al. 2026 ; Wang et al. 2026b ) . IDEAL outlines a liver-surgery decision-support framework that brings together multimodal evidence, three-dimensional anatomy, functional information, and explicit constraints ( Wang et al. 2026a ) . However, these methods do not provide one case-centered workflow that connects image preparation, image-based measurement, visual evidence, interactive correction, and resection planning. This gap motivates a system that coordinates specialized tools while keeping every result tied to its source data.
blocks.zh: 现有方法处理这项任务的个别部分。 VISTA3D,TotalSectionator,和BiomedParse提供自动或即时制导的医学图像分解(He等人,2001年). 2025; Wasserthal等人著. CT-CLIP将卷状CT与文本连接起来(Hamamci等人,2026年);以及CT-Agent和3DMedAgent为多步骤CT推理组织专门工具和选定证据(Mao等人,2025年). 2026; 王等编. 2026b. (中文(简体) ). EIDAL概述了肝外科决策支持框架,该框架汇集了多模式证据、三维解剖、功能信息以及明确的制约因素(Wang等人,2026a)。 然而,这些方法并不能提供一种以案例为中心的工作流程,将图像准备,基于图像的测量,视觉证据,交互式校正,以及重新分解规划联系起来. 这种差距促使一个系统协调专门的工具,同时保持每个结果与源数据挂钩。

blocks.en: To address this need, we present VoxelSage, an online multimodal system for two- and three-dimensional visualization, liver-tumor analysis, and preoperative resection and sequential planning. To separate language-based coordination from computations that require image geometry and to keep the system extensible, VoxelSage uses a dual-port architecture: Port A interprets user requests, maintains the case context, selects skills, and integrates returned evidence, whereas Port B performs segmentation and applies the selected skills to the CT volume and segmentation masks. Figure 1 summarizes this reasoning–execution loop and the data exchanged between the browser, Port A, and Port B.
blocks.zh: 为了满足这一需要,我们提出了VoxelSage,这是一个在线多模式系统,用于二维和三维可视化、肝肿瘤分析以及手术前重新剖面和顺序规划。 为了将基于语言的协调与需要图像几何的计算区分开来并保持系统的可扩展性,VoxelSage使用双端口架构: 端口 A解释用户请求,维护案件上下文,选择技能,并整合返回的证据,而Port B则进行分割,并将选定的技能应用于CT卷和分割口罩. 图1概括了这个推理-执行循环以及浏览器,Port A和Port B之间交换的数据.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: 1. A dual-port architecture that separates task coordination from image computation. To prevent the language model from generating physical-space measurements directly, Port A handles request interpretation and skill selection, while Port B performs the segmentation and the corresponding computation on the CT volume and segmentation masks. To reduce repeated computation and improve efficiency, Port A caches the result received from Port B. For cross-case analysis, Port A also supports explicit file selection, allowing users to specify which cases to include and keeping the analysis focused on the selected files. Eight built-in skills return structured results for analysis, visualization, correction, and planning, or explicit errors on failure. 2. A learned sequential resection planning method with “shield”. The system uses a bicubic Bézier surface to define the planned resection area. On a two-dimensional grid derived from the saved surface, a frozen behavior-cloned neural ranker orders candidate targets, while a simulator-based “shield” excludes candidates that would lead to excessive simulated blood loss or violate other predefined constraints.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 一个将任务协调与图像计算分开的双端口架构. 为了防止语言模型直接生成物理空间测量,Port A手柄请求解释和技能选择,而Port B则在CT卷和分解口罩上进行分解和相应的计算. 为了减少重复计算并提高效率,Port A缓存从Port B收到的结果. 对于跨案件分析,Port A也支持明确的文件选择,允许用户指定哪些案件可以包含,并保持分析集中于选定的文件. 8个内置技能返回结构化结果,用于分析、可视化、校正和规划,或者在故障时出现明显错误。 2. 学习到的有 " 屏蔽 " 的顺序调整规划方法。 系统使用双立体贝塞尔表面来定义计划中的剖面区域. 在从保存的表面衍生出来的二维网格上,一个冰冻的行为克隆神经分级器命令候选目标,而一个基于模拟器的“屏蔽”则排除了会导致过度模拟失血或违反其他预定限制的候选人。

blocks.en: To evaluate the online system and the learned controller, we use two evaluation settings. An illustrative single-case demonstration shows the end-to-end online workflow, while a three-case functional matrix using public colorectal liver metastasis CT data verifies the online data flow and Port B skill interfaces. A frozen two-dimensional simulator measures the effect of neural target ordering under controlled assumptions. The image-analysis interface uses only liver, tumor, and vessel masks, and it does not use information about whether a tumor is primary liver cancer or a metastasis from another organ. Therefore, evaluation on colorectal liver metastasis cases alone does not establish that the system generalizes to primary liver cancer or to tumors with other origins. The reported evaluation supports engineering integration and simulator-level behavior only, clinical performance and surgical safety require future validation.
blocks.zh: 为了评价在线系统和学习控制器,我们使用两个评价设置。 一个说明性单例演示显示了端到端的在线工作流程,而使用公共色谱肝元CT数据的三例功能矩阵则验证在线数据流和Port B技能接口. 一个冷冻的二维模拟器在受控的假设下测量神经目标命令的效果. 图像分析接口只使用肝脏,肿瘤,以及容器口罩,它不使用肿瘤是主肝癌还是来自另一器官的元化信息. 因此,仅对内分泌肝元硬化病例的评价并不能确定系统对原发性肝癌或具有其他起源的肿瘤的概括. 报告评价支持工程整合和模拟水平行为,临床表现和手术安全需要未来验证.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Three-Dimensional Medical Image Segmentation
blocks.zh: 2.1 三面体医疗图像分解

blocks.en: Segmentation is the geometric foundation for CT-based liver assessment: downstream volume, diameter, distance, and surface-reconstruction results are only meaningful when the liver, lesions, and vessels share a reliable spatial reference system. Recent general-purpose approaches have substantially broadened the structures and interaction modes available to a medical-imaging pipeline. VISTA3D provides a unified framework for three-dimensional segmentation with automatic and prompt-guided use cases ( He et al. 2025 ) ; TotalSegmentator provides broad multi-structure CT segmentation ( Wasserthal et al. 2023 ) ; and BiomedParse explores text-conditioned segmentation, detection, and recognition across biomedical images ( Zhao et al. 2025 ) . These models make it practical to obtain masks for analysis without training a distinct segmentation model for every structure or downstream task.
blocks.zh: 分化是CT基肝脏评估的几何基础:下游体积,直径,距离,以及表面重建结果只有在肝脏,损伤,和血管共享可靠的空间参考系统时才有意义. 最近的一般用途方法大大扩展了医疗成像管道可用的结构和互动模式。 VISTA3D为三维分割提供了统一的框架,具有自动和即时制导的使用案例(He等人,2025年);TotalSector提供了广泛的多结构CT分割(Wasserthal等人,2023年);BiomedParse探索了跨生物医学图像的文本条件分割,检测和识别(Zhao等人,2025年)。 这些模型使得获得用于分析的口罩成为了实用,而无需为每个结构或下游任务培训一个独特的分解模型.

blocks.en: Their outputs, however, are not themselves a complete preoperative-analysis system. In particular, a multi-label segmentation volume must still be normalized to a common image geometry, converted into lesion instances, checked for consistency across vessel-mask versions and connected to physical-space measurements and visible evidence. Our work adopts VISTA3D as the default backend for the current segmentation pipeline while retaining interfaces to alternative backends. Rather than proposing a new segmentation model, we focus on making segmentation a traceable case-level input to deterministic quantification, interactive visualization, and experimental planning. This distinction is important because the present system demonstrates workflow integration, not a comparative claim of segmentation superiority.
blocks.zh: 然而,其产出本身并不是一个完整的操作前分析系统。 特别是,多标签分块量仍必须恢复正常化为通用图像几何,转换成损伤情况,检查容器-掩体版本的一致性,并与物理空间测量和可见证据连接。 我们的工作采用VISTA3D作为当前分割管道的默认后端,同时保留替代后端的接口. 我们没有提出一个新的分化模型,而是侧重于使分化成为可追踪的个案级投入,用于确定量化、互动可视化和实验规划。 这种区分很重要,因为目前的系统显示工作流程一体化,而不是比较地声称分化优越。

blocks.en: 2.2 Multimodal Medical Agents
blocks.zh: 2.2 多式联运代理商

blocks.en: Multimodal medical models increasingly connect images, reports, and question answering, but three-dimensional CT remains difficult to present directly to a general-purpose model. CT-CLIP demonstrates that volumetric CT features can be aligned with clinical text ( Hamamci et al. 2026 ) . Tool-augmented medical agents address this challenge from a different perspective. CT-Agent supports chest CT question answering and report generation through anatomy-specific tools and global–local token compression, illustrating how tool organization and structured representations can reduce the burden of full-volume reasoning ( Mao et al. 2026 ) . 3DMedAgent further emphasizes organ-aware memory, selective evidence acquisition, and the reuse of heterogeneous tool outputs for general CT question answering ( Wang et al. 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 多式联运医疗模型越来越多地连接图像、报告和问答,但三维CT仍然难以直接呈现给通用模型。 CT-CLIP表明,体积CT特征可以与临床文本一致(Hamamci等人,2026年). 工具化医疗人员从不同角度应对这一挑战。 CT-Agent支持通过解剖学特定工具和全局-局部符号压缩来解答和生成胸前CT问题并生成报告,说明工具组织和结构化的表示如何可以减轻全卷推理的负担(Mao等人,2026年). 3DMedAgent进一步强调器官感知记忆,选择性证据获取,以及不同工具输出的再利用,用于一般CT问题回答(Wang等人,2026b.).

blocks.en: These efforts motivate the use of a language model in our own system as an orchestrator rather than as a substitute for geometric computation. Building on this tool-augmented perspective, the present system focuses on an online liver-analysis workflow: a case identifier binds the CT, masks, measurements, images, and three-dimensional assets, while a dedicated imaging service executes the requested operations. Within this workflow, a reported volume, diameter, or tumor–vessel distance is returned together with its associated mask and affine basis, rather than relying on the language model to infer the result from conversational context alone. Our contribution is to organize language-guided skill selection, image-based measurement, evidence review, interactive correction, and resection planning into a case-centered workflow for liver CT analysis.
blocks.zh: 这些努力促使我们在自己的系统中使用一种语言模型作为管弦乐器,而不是取代几何计算。 基于这个工具增强的视角,目前的系统侧重于在线肝脏分析工作流程:一个案例标识符将CT,口罩,测量,图像,以及三维资产绑定在一起,而专用的成像服务则执行请求的操作. 在这个工作流程中,一个报告的体积、直径或肿瘤 — — 韦塞尔距离与其相关的面具和亲缘基础一起返回,而不是依赖语言模型来推断仅从对话背景中得出的结果。 我们的贡献是组织语言指导技能选择、图像测量、证据审查、互动校正和重新分解规划,使之成为肝脏CT分析的以案例为中心的工作流程。

blocks.en: 2.3 Liver Surgery Planning
blocks.zh: 2.3 肝手术规划

blocks.en: Liver surgery planning requires more than lesion localization. Candidate treatment or resection strategies must be considered in the context of three-dimensional tumor distribution, intrahepatic vessels, safety margins, retained parenchyma, and patient-specific clinical information. A systematic review found that three-dimensional liver reconstruction is used mainly for planning complex or major resections, but also highlighted heterogeneous and predominantly non-randomized evidence ( Banchini et al. 2024 ) . Future liver remnant volume and function are central clinical quantities that remain outside our current geometric planner ( Urraro et al. 2025 ) . IDEAL describes a framework that brings multimodal evidence, three-dimensional anatomy, functional reserve, and explicit safety constraints to support precision liver-surgery decision making ( Wang et al. 2026a ) . This line of work establishes the value of integrating image-derived anatomy with constraints that surgeons can inspect and discuss, instead of treating a segmentation result as the final planning output.
blocks.zh: 肝外科手术规划需要的不仅仅是损伤局部化. 候选人的治疗或重新剖析策略必须在三维肿瘤分布、肝脏内脏血管、安全幅度、保有的parenchyma和针对病人的临床信息的背景下加以考虑。 一项系统的审查发现,三维肝脏重建主要用于规划复杂或重大重新剖析,但也突出了各种和主要非随机性的证据(Banchini等人,2024年)。 未来的肝脏残留体积和功能是临床中心体积,仍在我们目前的几何规划器之外(Urraro等人,2025年)。 IDEAL描述了一个框架,它带来多种模式证据、三维解剖学、功能储备以及明确的安全限制,以支持精确肝外科决策(Wang等人,2026a)。 这项工作确立了将图像生成的解剖学与外科医生可以检查和讨论的限制因素相结合的价值,而不是将分解结果作为最后规划产出。

blocks.en: Deformable Bézier surfaces with distance-map margin visualization and NURBS-based virtual resections are established approaches to liver-resection planning ( Palomar et al. 2017 ; d’Albenzio et al. 2024 ) . Our contribution combines automatic candidate generation and margin refinement with user-confirmed, simulator-shielded target ordering. Starting from the liver, tumor, portal-vein, and hepatic-vein masks, it exposes tumor-distance, vessel-proximity, area, and curvature summaries in a browser scene. It does not model liver function, segmental perfusion, deformable anatomy, instrument mechanics, or postoperative outcomes; nor does it rank treatments as a clinical decision system.
blocks.zh: 可变形贝塞尔表面具有远程映射边距可视化和基于NURBS的虚拟剖面是肝脏剖面规划的既定方法(Palomar等人,2017年;d'Albenzio等人,2024年). 我们的贡献将自动生成候选人和完善比值与用户确认、模拟和屏蔽的目标订单结合起来。 从肝脏、肿瘤、门户、肝脏口罩开始, 它不模拟肝功能,分泌,变形解剖,仪器力学,或术后结果;也不将治疗列为临床决定系统.

blocks.en: 2.4 Human-in-the-Loop Medical Systems
blocks.zh: 2.4 人环医疗系统

blocks.en: Human oversight is especially important when an imaging output can influence interpretation or planning. In this setting, useful collaboration requires more than showing a model prediction: users need access to the evidence behind a measurement, a means to correct or reject an intermediate result, and a clear record of what was accepted. Tool-augmented CT systems such as CT-Agent and 3DMedAgent provide relevant precedents for evidence selection, structured intermediate results, and question-driven tool use ( Mao et al. 2026 ; Wang et al. 2026b ) . DECIDE-AI emphasizes transparent reporting of early clinical evaluation, human factors, and workflow effects ( Vasey et al. 2022 ) ; those requirements frame future evaluation rather than evidence already supplied by this technical report.
blocks.zh: 当成像输出能够影响解释或规划时,人类监督尤其重要。 在这一背景下,有益的协作需要的不仅仅是显示模型预测:用户需要获取计量背后的证据,一种纠正或拒绝中间结果的手段,以及一个被接受内容的明确记录. CT-Agent和3DMedAgent等工具化CT系统为证据选择,结构化中间结果,以及问题驱动工具的使用提供了相关先例(Mao等人. 2026; 王等编. 2026b. (中文(简体) ). DECIDE-AI强调以透明的方式报告早期临床评价、人的因素和工作流程的影响(Vasey等人,2022年);这些要求是未来评价的框架,而不是本技术报告已经提供的证据。

blocks.en: We operationalize this principle at two explicit boundaries. First, segmentation edits are user initiated and preserved as affine-aware case artifacts, allowing subsequent measurements and visualizations to identify the data on which they depend. Second, a resection candidate may be inspected and edited through its 4 × 4 4\times 4 control grid, but downstream sequence planning accepts only a surface that the user has explicitly saved. Edits invalidate older saved states and paths rather than silently propagating them. These mechanisms do not establish clinical safety or usability; they define an inspectable research workflow in which the system proposes computational evidence and experimental geometry while the human retains modification and confirmation authority.
blocks.zh: 我们在两个明确界限上实施这一原则。 首先,分区编辑是作为亲和意识的个案文物发起和保存的用户,允许后续的测量和可视化来识别它们所依赖的数据. 第二,重新剖析候选者可以通过其4×4 4\times 4控制网格进行检查和编辑,但下游序列规划只接受用户明确保存的表面. 编辑无效的旧保存状态和路径,而不是默默地宣传它们. 这些机制并不确立临床安全性或使用性;它们界定了可检查的研究流程,其中系统提出计算证据和实验几何,而人类保留修改和确认权威。

blocks.en: 3 System Overview
blocks.zh: 3 系统概览

blocks.en: VoxelSage is a multimodal-agent system for three-dimensional (3D) liver CT analysis. Given a liver CT image and a natural-language request, our agent interprets the request, selects and calls the required analysis skills, and returns a response based on computation evidence. The current implementation and evaluation use public cases from the TCIA Colorectal-Liver-Metastases collection.
blocks.zh: VoxelSage是一个用于三维(3D)肝CT分析的多模式代理系统. 鉴于肝脏CT图像和自然语言请求,我们的代理解释请求,选择和调用所需的分析技能,并返回基于计算证据的回复. 目前的实施和评价使用TCIA Colorectal-Liver-Metastases收藏的公案.

blocks.en: 3.1 System Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.1 系统架构

blocks.en: To integrate existing analysis tools into a unified workflow and keep the system extensible for new analysis functions, we design a dual-port architecture, which separates general agent functions and specialized medical-image computation in two different ports, one for agent orchestration and the other for computational skills registration. The architecture in Figure 1 shows that our work includes a browser workspace and two ports. The browser provides a lightweight and user-friendly agent interface for main dialogue and interactive functions like segmentation correction. Port A handles the task of agent orchestration. It interprets user requests, maintains case context, and coordinates language-model reasoning with skill calls to Port B. Port B is the medical-image computation end, with different CT analysis skills registered. When receiving skill calls, it performs the requested deterministic computation and returns structured results as evidence to Port A for further reasoning.
blocks.zh: 为了将现有的分析工具纳入统一的工作流程,并使系统能够用于新的分析功能,我们设计了一个双端端口结构,在两个不同的端口将一般代理功能和专门的医疗图像计算分开,一个用于代理管弦,另一个用于计算技能登记。 图1中的架构显示,我们的工作包括一个浏览器工作空间和两个端口. 浏览器提供了一个轻量级和方便用户的代理界面,用于主对话框和交互功能,如分区校正. 端口 一个处理代理管弦乐的任务. 它诠释用户请求,维护案例上下文,用技能呼叫B港来协调语言模型推理. Port B是医学图像计算端,注册了不同的CT分析技能. 在接听技能呼叫时,它进行所要求的确定性计算,并将结构化的结果作为证据返回A港作进一步推理.

blocks.en: 3.2 Overall Workflow
blocks.zh: 3.2 总体工作流量

blocks.en: To support case preparation, on-demand skill use, and case-specific evidence flow within the dual-port architecture, the system follows the workflow below: First, in the browser interface, users upload DICOM series or NIfTI volumes that they want to analyze. After receiving the file path, Port A assigns a unique case id to every case and initializes the corresponding case context, and sends the file paths to Port B for case pre-processing and pre-analysis. Then, Port B prepares and segments the CT data and returns the resulting files, status, and basic analysis results to Port A. After case preparation, the user can submit a natural-language question with optional references to available files. Based on users’ input, case contexts, and available tool list sent by Port B, Port A builds the current agent context, and sends it to the language model to reason whether available case evidence is sufficient to answer user’s question. If sufficient, the model prepares a response directly; otherwise, it selects appropriate skills and prepares necessary parameters to get more evidence through medical-image computation. Later, the skill calls are further arranged via Port A and sent to Port B. In Port B, the target case is processed by selected skills, and then structured results together with relevant artifacts, such as images, three-dimensional views, or planning outputs, are returned to Port A. Port A integrates the returned evidence into context, then send back to the language model to determine whether produces the final response or starts another reasoning round (sending skill calls to Port B, collecting evidence returned from Port B, and reasoning with evidence to determine whether to produce the final response) when additional evidence is required. To prevent infinite loop, the agent loop is limited to six rounds. If exceeded, the agent will collect logs from both ports to show failure reason. Throughout the workflow, for giving user feedback of execution progress, the browser displays processing status.
blocks.zh: 为了支持案件准备、按需使用技能以及双端端口结构内具体案件证据的流动,该系统遵循以下工作流程: 首先,在浏览器界面中,用户上传DICOM系列或他们想要分析的NIfTI卷. 收到文件路径后,Port A为每个案例指派一个独特的大小写id并初始化相应的大小写上下文,并将文件路径发送给Port B进行案件预处理和预分析. 然后,B号港口准备和分解CT数据,并将由此产生的文件,状态和基本分析结果返回A号港口. 在案件准备之后,用户可以提交一个自然语言问题,同时可选择引用现有文件. 基于用户的输入,案例背景,以及Port B发送的可用工具列表,Port A构建了当前代理上下文,并将其发送给语言模型,以说明现有案例证据是否足以回答用户的问题. 如果足够,模型直接准备一个响应;否则,它会选择适当的技能,并准备必要的参数,通过医学-图像计算获得更多的证据. 后来,技能呼叫通过A港进一步安排,发送到B港. 在B港,目标案例通过选定的技能处理,然后与图像,三维视图,或规划产出等相关文物一起结构化的结果被送回A港. 端口 一个将返回的证据融入到上下文中,然后发回语言模型,以确定是生成最终回复还是开始另一轮推理(向B港发送技能呼叫,收集从B港返回的证据,以及有证据的推理以确定是否生成最终回复),此时需要补充证据. 为了防止无限循环,代理循环限于6发. 如果超过,代理人将从两个端口收集日志以显示失败原因. 在整个工作流程中,为了给用户提供执行进度的反馈,浏览器会显示处理状态.

blocks.en: 3.3 Browser Workspace
blocks.zh: 3.3 浏览器工作空间

blocks.en: The browser workspace is the interaction and presentation layer for upload, task monitoring, dialogue, evidence review, editing, and confirmation. It displays case-linked structured results and artifacts returned through the architecture in Figure 1 ; the browser does not compute measurements or alter the source CT data; it sends saved user edits to the backend, which updates the corresponding segmentation or planning artifacts.
blocks.zh: 浏览器工作空间是上传,任务监测,对话,证据审查,编辑,确认的交互和演示层. 它在图1中显示与大小写相连的结构化结果和通过架构返回的文物;浏览器不计算测量结果或更改源CT数据;它向后端发送保存的用户编辑,后端更新相应的分区或规划文物.

blocks.en: After upload and validation, Port A assigns the DICOM series or NIfTI volume a case_id and submits case preparation. The frontend reports processing or failure state and loads the returned CT, masks, and visual artifacts. The interface displays not only the final answer but also the intermediate evidence that supports it: per-lesion measurement cards, ranked axial slices with contour overlays, and the interactive 3D scene. This arrangement lets the user inspect the case-linked evidence of each quantitative claim before acting on it. Matching cases may reuse valid results; changed inputs invalidate dependent artifacts.
blocks.zh: 上传和验证后,端口A会指定DICOM系列或NIfTI卷一个大小写_id并提交大小写准备. 前端报告处理或故障状态,并装入返回的CT,口罩,和视觉文物. 界面不仅显示最终答案,还显示支持它的中间证据: per-lesion测量卡,用轮廓覆盖排列轴片,以及交互式3D场景. 这一安排使用户在采取行动之前先检查每个定量索赔的个案证据。 匹配的案例可以重复使用有效结果;变更输入会使依赖的文物失效.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Integrated browser workspace for illustrative case CRLM-CT-1012. The panels combine case management, dialogue, skill execution, and case-linked evidence; the reconstruction panel shows the liver, tumor, portal vein, and hepatic vein in a shared scene.
blocks.zh: 图 2:用于说明性案例CRLM-CT-1012的集成浏览器工作空间. 这些板块结合了案件管理、对话、技能执行和与案件相关的证据;重建板块显示共用场景中的肝脏、肿瘤、门户静脉和肝脏静脉。

blocks.en: Figure 2 combines case management, dialogue, and skill-specific evidence. Requests carry the active case_id; Port A discovers skill descriptions through /api/skills/list and submits validated calls to /api/skills/run as described in the orchestration section. The workspace distinguishes the user request, current case state, requested skill, execution status, and returned artifacts. It therefore shows whether a response reused context or triggered computation and presents missing prerequisites or failures explicitly.
blocks.zh: 图2结合了案件管理、对话和技能方面的具体证据。 请求带有活动大小写_ id; 端口 通过/api/技能/列表发现技能描述,并向/api/技能/运行提交经证实的电话,如管弦乐部分所述。 工作空间区分用户请求,当前大小写状态,请求技能,执行状态,以及返回的文物. 因此,它表明一个响应是再利用上下文还是触发了计算,并明确提出缺失的先决条件或失败。

blocks.en: Together, case-scoped upload and visible execution state keep conversational requests tied to the data and computation that support each response. This case-level link is the basis for the evidence-review and correction workflows described in Section 5 .The workspace distinguishes three artifact states: generated candidates awaiting review, temporary edits that remain session-local, and explicitly saved artifacts that downstream skills may consume. This distinction lets the interface preserve user control over state-changing operations: segmentation edits take effect only after a deliberate save, and resection planning accepts only a surface that the user has explicitly confirmed. Temporary segmentation edits or unconfirmed resection surfaces cannot enter subsequent computation.
blocks.zh: 案例扫描的上传和可见的执行状态加在一起,使对话请求与支持每个响应的数据绑定在一起并进行计算. 这一案件级链接是第5节所述证据审查和纠正工作流程的基础。 工作空间区分了三个文物状态:生成的待审查候选人,仍然为会场局部的临时编辑,以及明确保存下游技能可能消耗的文物. 这种区分让界面保留了用户对状态变化操作的控制:分区编辑只有在故意保存后才生效,重新分区规划只接受用户明确确认的表面. 临时分区编辑或未经证实的重新分区表面不能输入后续计算.

blocks.en: 4 Agent Orchestration
blocks.zh: 4个代理管弦乐团

blocks.en: Port A coordinates the agent loop between user requests and medical-image computation in Port B. The following subsections will illustrate the functions of Port A shown in Figure 1 in detail.
blocks.zh: 端口 A协调用户请求和B港医疗图像计算之间的代理循环. 以下各小节将详细说明图1所示的A港的功能。

blocks.en: 4.1 Case Setup and State Management
blocks.zh: 4.1 案件设置和国家管理

blocks.en: Port A first checks whether an uploaded file is a supported DICOM series or NIfTI (.nii.gz) volume. After the check succeeds, it creates a case context and assigns the case a unique UUID. The case context stores five types of information: the source image, segmentation masks produced during pre-processing, historical medical-image computation results, and file status. The UUID associates source and derived files (e.g. segmented masks) and computational results (e.g. volume of the liver) with the same case, which can effectively avoid misuse. Also, to track progress and handle failures, Port A records file status, processing status, skill execution states, and errors for each case in the process.
blocks.zh: 端口 首先检查一个上传的文件是支持的DICOM系列还是NIfTI(.nii.gz)卷. 在检查成功后,它创建了大小写上下文,并指定了该大小写独特的UUID. 病例上下文存储了五种信息:源图像,在预处理过程中产生的分割口罩,历史医学图像计算结果,以及文件状态. UUID将源和衍生文件(如片面口罩)和计算结果(如肝体积)与同一种情况联系起来,可以有效避免误用. 另外,为了跟踪进度和处理故障,Port A记录文件状态,处理状态,技能执行状态,以及过程中每个案件的错误.

blocks.en: After a skill completes successfully, its structured output (medical-image computation results) is stored in the case context as a case-level cache entry. To reuse a previous computation only for an equivalent request and avoid cache misuse, each entry is indexed by the case UUID, skill name, and input parameters. Port A reuses the output only when all three fields match.
blocks.zh: 在技能成功完成后,其结构化输出(医学-图像计算结果)作为案例级缓存条目存储在案例上下文中. 为了只为等效请求重新使用之前的计算,并避免缓存误用,每个条目都按照案例UUID,技能名称和输入参数索引. 端口 只有在三个字段都匹配时才能重用输出 。

blocks.en: 4.2 Agent Context Construction
blocks.zh: 4.2 代理上下文构建

blocks.en: To enable the language model to select an appropriate skill for the current request, Port A first obtains the available skill definition list from Port B. Each definition specifies the skill function, input parameters, prerequisites, and output fields, allowing the language model to understand the function of the skill and what parameters should be provided for skill calling. Port A then combines this skill definition list with the current user request, the historical dialogue, and the case context of the referenced case to construct the current agent context. This context is provided to the language model so that its decision is based on the referenced case and the evidence already obtained.
blocks.zh: 为了使语言模型能够为当前请求选择适当的技能,Port A首先从Port B获得可用的技能定义列表. 每个定义都具体规定了技能函数,输入参数,先决条件,以及输出字段,使语言模型能够理解技能的功能,以及为技能调用提供哪些参数. 端口 A然后将这个技能定义列表与当前用户请求,历史对话框,以及引用大小写的案例上下文结合起来,构建当前代理上下文. 这种背景提供给语文模式,以便其决定以参考案件和已经获得的证据为依据。

blocks.en: 4.3 Language Model Decision and Skill Execution
blocks.zh: 4.3 语言示范决定和技能处决

blocks.en: After receiving the current agent context, Qwen first determines whether the available evidence is sufficient to answer the current user request. If the evidence is sufficient, Qwen generates the response directly. Otherwise, it selects one or more skills from the skill definition list and generates the corresponding skill calls with the required input parameters. Before sending a selected skill call to Port B, Port A checks whether the case context already contains a cache entry with the same case UUID, skill name, and input parameters. If such an entry exists, Port A directly reuses its structured output. Otherwise, it sends a new call to Port B. This check avoids repeated computation for an equivalent request while preventing cache misuse.
blocks.zh: 收到当前代理上下文后, Quen首先确定现有证据是否足以回答当前用户的请求. 如果证据充分,Quen直接生成回复. 否则,它会从技能定义列表中选择一个或多个技能,并生成带有所需输入参数的相应技能呼叫. 在向Port B发送一个选定的技能调用之前,Port A检查大小写上下文是否已经包含一个缓存条目,包含相同的大小写UUID,技能名称,以及输入参数. 如果存在这样的条目,Port A直接重用其结构化输出. 否则,它向B港发出新的呼叫. 此检查可避免重复计算等效请求,同时防止缓存误用.

blocks.en: When a request requires multiple new computations, Port A sends calls for independent skills to Port B concurrently to reduce waiting time. When one skill requires the output of another skill, Port A sends the calls in sequence so that each skill receives its prerequisite input. Receiving the skill calls from Port A, Port B executes the selected skills on the referenced case and returns structured outputs, generated artifacts, execution states, or explicit errors to Port A. Based on these new information, Port A then rebuilds the context and sends to the language model to judge whether evidence is sufficient. If additional evidence is required, the agent repeats this language model decision and skill execution loop. To prevent infinite agent loop error, the system limits the number of reasoning rounds. If the limit is exceeded, Port A stops further skill calls and asks the language model to review the execution log and return a possible explanation for the unresolved error.
blocks.zh: 当一个请求需要多个新的计算时,Port A会同时向Port B发出独立技能的呼叫,以减少等待时间. 当一种技能需要输出另一种技能时,Port A会按顺序发出调用,使每种技能都得到其先决条件输入. 收到来自Port A的技巧调用,Port B执行被引用的案件中的选定技能并返回结构化输出,生成文物,执行状态,或向Port A明确错误. 根据这些新信息,Port A然后重建上下文并发送到语言模型,以判断证据是否足够. 如果需要额外证据,代理商会重复这种语言模型决定和技能执行循环. 为了防止无限代理循环错误,系统限制了推理回合的数量. 如果超过限制,Port A会停止更多的技能呼叫,并要求语言模型审查执行日志,并返回对未解决错误的可能解释.

blocks.en: 4.4 Result Integration and Response Preparation
blocks.zh: 4.4 成果整合和反应准备

blocks.en: After Port B returns a successful skill result, Port A adds its structured output and generated artifacts to the case context. The output is also retained as a case-level cache entry; therefore, when a later conversation requests the same skill with the same input parameters for the same case UUID, Port A can reuse the existing result instead of repeating the computation.
blocks.zh: 端口之后 B返回一个成功的技能结果,A港在案件上下文中增加了其结构化产出和生成的文物. 输出也作为案例级缓存条目保留;因此,当后期对话要求相同技能,对同一案例的输入参数相同时UUID,Port A可以重用现有结果而不是重复计算.

blocks.en: Before Port A presents a result to the user, it performs basic range and consistency checks on the returned medical-image computation results. These checks identify possible unit errors or computational anomalies and allow the system to mark the affected result for review. Also, When the workflow fails, Port B will return the log of error to Port A. In turn, Port A adds the error information and a recovery direction to the agent context, allowing the language model to re-enter the reasoning loop and try to fix this error (e.g. adjust the skill calling parameters). However, if the error cannot be recovered, Port A will return a report of execution failure to the user.
blocks.zh: 在端口之前 A向用户提供结果,对返回的医疗图像计算结果进行基本范围和一致性检查。 这些检查查明了可能的单位错误或计算异常,使系统能够标记受影响的结果以供审查。 另外,当工作流程失败时,Port B会将错误日志还给Port A. 转而,Port A在代理上下文中增加了错误信息和恢复方向,使得语言模型可以重新进入推理循环,并尝试纠正这个错误(如调整技能调用参数). 然而,如果错误无法恢复,Port A会将执行失败的报告退回给用户.

blocks.en: 5 Medical Imaging Skills
blocks.zh: 5 医疗成像技能

blocks.en: To keep CT analysis extensible without coupling image-processing code to language-model orchestration, we isolate medical-imaging operations in Port B. Port A invokes these operations through schemas exposed from each skill’s skill.yaml manifest, while Port B owns case preparation, deterministic computation, and artifact generation. VoxelSage currently provides eight built-in skills and accepts user-supplied packages that follow the registration contract in Appendix A.2 .
blocks.zh: 为了保持CT分析的可扩展性,而不将图像处理代码与语言模型的管弦乐相配合,我们在B港隔离医疗成像操作. 端口 A通过从每种技能中暴露出来的计划来引用这些操作。 雅姆尔列表, 而端口 B拥有案例准备,定型计算,以及文物生成. VoxelSage目前提供8种内置技能,并接受在附录A.2中遵循注册合同的用户提供包.

blocks.en: For a traceable analysis-and-review loop, the built-in skills are organized into four roles. Measurement skills return mask-derived quantities, evidence-generation skills create inspectable two- and three-dimensional artifacts, interactive correction revises masks under explicit user control, and confirmation-gated sequence planning operates only on a user-saved surface. Table 5 in Appendix Appendix A summarizes the eight manifests. The following subsections explain the operating principles of these skills, how the shared preparation stage makes their outputs spatially consistent, how they expose evidence, and how user confirmation controls state-changing operations.
blocks.zh: 对于可追踪的分析-审查循环,内置技能被组织成四个角色. 测量技能 返回口罩衍生数量,证据生成技能 创建可检查的二维和三维文物,互动校正在明确用户控制下修改口罩,确认的序列规划仅在用户保存的表面运行. 附录中的表5 A总结八种品. 以下小节解释了这些技能的操作原则,共享准备阶段如何使其输出在空间上一致,如何暴露证据,以及用户确认如何控制状态变化的操作.

blocks.en: 5.1 Case Preparation
blocks.zh: 5.1 案件准备

blocks.en: Figure 3: Case preparation and medical-image analysis pipeline. DICOM or NIfTI input is normalized into a canonical case volume. Segmentation and post-processing then produce affine-aligned artifacts that are reused by on-demand quantitative, two-dimensional evidence, and three-dimensional planning skills.
blocks.zh: 图3:案件准备和医疗图像分析管道。 DICOM或NIfTI输入常态化为犬科病例卷. 分解和加工后再生产出由点播量,二维证据,三维规划技能再利用的芬芳配合文物.

blocks.en: To ensure that every downstream skill uses the same patient-space geometry, the preparation service converts DICOM series or NIfTI CT volumes into a common set of case-linked artifacts (Figure 3 ). The pipeline has three stages: 1. Image standardization. To prevent physically misregistered overlays and spacing errors, DICOM series are con verted to case-specific NIfTI volumes, while NIfTI files are used directly. Each volume is loaded in canonical RAS+ orientation and retains its 4 × 4 4\times 4 affine matrix. The mapping 𝒙 = 𝐀 ​ 𝒊 \boldsymbol{x}=\mathbf{A}\boldsymbol{i} converts the homogeneous voxel index 𝒊 = [ i , j , k , 1 ] 𝖳 \boldsymbol{i}=[i,j,k,1]^{\mathsf{T}} to millimetre coordinates. Masks on another orientation or grid are canonicalized and, when needed, resampled to the CT grid with nearest-neighbour interpola tion. To serve both display and intensity-sensitive analysis, the service also creates an 8-bit abdominal-window volume at level 40 40 HU and width 400 400 HU while retaining the unwindowed HU data. The CT path, affine, shape, and output directory are recorded under the case identifier used by later skill calls. 2. Automated segmentation. VISTA3D ( He et al. 2025 ) serves as the default backend for producing the liver, hepatic-tumor, portal-vein, and hepatic-vein masks required by liver-tumor analysis. These masks are written as NIfTI artifacts. TotalSegmentator ( Wasserthal et al. 2023 ) is available as an alternative backend. 3. Post-processing. Post-processing gives every skill a canonical mask contract by normalizing backend-specific names and decomposing the aggregate hepatic-tumor mask into three-dimensional connected components. Components below the configurable voxel threshold are not materialized as lesion-specific masks, which keeps likely fragments out of per-lesion geometry. Because segmentation can leave short, artificial breaks in structures that should be connected, vessel optimization constructs a separate, continuity-corrected mask variant for downstream vessel-dependent analysis. Portal- and hepatic-vein masks are skeletonized, and candidate terminal gaps of at most 4 4 mm are evaluated. blocks.en: 5.2 Quantitative Measurement Skills
blocks.zh: 5.2 计量技能

blocks.en: To answer quantitative questions without asking the language model to infer geometry from screenshots, four skills compute structured measurements from the prepared masks and affine. liver_analysis returns liver and vessel volumes, per-lesion diameters, tumor–vessel distances, and a formatted report in one call. tumor_diameter, tumor_vessel_distance, and vessel_volume expose the corresponding quantities separately when a focused query does not require the full report. To avoid repeated computation, Port A can reuse relevant fields from the integrated results for focused follow-up questions. Before measurement, the preparation stage can split the aggregate hepatic-tumor mask into separate per-lesion component masks so that each lesion is measured independently. For a binary structure mask M M , physical volume is V ( M ) = ( ∑ 𝒊 𝕀 [ M ( 𝒊 ) > 0 ] ) | det ( 𝐀 1 : 3 , 1 : 3 ) | , V(M)=\left(\sum_{\boldsymbol{i}}\mathbb{I}[M(\boldsymbol{i})>0]\right)\left|\det\left(\mathbf{A}_{1:3,1:3}\right)\right|, (1) where the determinant gives voxel volume in mm 3 \mathrm{mm}^{3} . Lesion count is therefore based on valid three-dimensional components rather than a single axial slice.

blocks.en: To report diameters in millimetres without assuming isotropic voxels, lesion coordinates are transformed through the affine before the maximum three-dimensional extent is estimated. Sufficiently large components use the maximum pairwise distance among convex-hull vertices. Smaller components use the maximum pairwise distance among all affine-transformed foreground voxel centres, while components below the minimum size threshold are labelled too small for a stable estimate.
blocks.zh: 如果报告直径为毫米,而不假定是异热带的氧化物,那么在估计最大三维范围之前,损害坐标会通过外缘改变。 足够大的部件在凸轮壳顶部使用最大对角距离. 较小的部件在所有外缘变形的前缘阴道中心中使用最大对比距离,而低于最小尺寸阈值的部件则贴上太小的标签,无法进行稳定的估计.

blocks.en: To expose potential tumor–vessel proximity, the implementation evaluates a Euclidean distance transform of the vessel complement over the tumor region ( Maurer et al. 2003 ) . The transform uses the three voxel spacings as per-axis sampling distances, giving the minimum foreground voxel-centre distance in millimetres on the aligned orthogonal grid, including anisotropic grids and their rigid rotations. Direct overlap is reported as zero; an empty tumor or vessel mask returns no distance. The result records the vessel-mask variant, minimum distance, and contact flag. Taken together, these measurements provide reproducible evidence derived from segmentation masks rather than independent diagnostic findings.
blocks.zh: 为了暴露潜在的肿瘤-韦塞尔近距离,该实施评估了该船在肿瘤区域上空的欧几利得距离变化(Maurer等人,2003年)。 变速器采用三个变速器间距作为每轴采样距离,使对齐正弦格上最小的前缘变速器间距以毫米表示,包括异位格及其刚性旋转. 直接重叠报告为零;空肿瘤或容器罩返回无距离。 结果记录了船只-面具的变体、最小距离和接触旗。 综合起来,这些测量提供了从分解口罩而不是独立诊断结论中得出的可复制的证据。

blocks.en: 5.3 Informative Slice Selection Skill and Two-Dimensional Evidence Review
blocks.zh: 5.3 资料片段选择技巧和双面证据审查

blocks.en: The slice_selection skill provides compact visual evidence without sending an entire CT volume to the conversational model by ranking axial slices and returning three by default. Masks are first aligned to the canonical CT grid. The score combines organ diversity, organ coverage, a lesion bonus, slice centrality, and image entropy, with an additional bonus when lesion and vessel masks co-occur. Candidates are selected in descending score order with a minimum axial separation, relaxed only when too few positive-scoring slices remain to fill the Top- K K set. Each result includes the score, a windowed CT PNG, and a radiologically oriented contour overlay.
blocks.zh: 切片_selection技巧提供紧凑的视觉证据,而不通过排列轴切片和默认返回3个来将整个CT卷发送到对话模型. 面具首先与犬科CT网格对齐. 分数结合了器官多样性,器官覆盖,损伤奖金,切片中心,以及影像 en,在损伤口罩和容器口罩共同粘合时附加奖金. 考生按照降分顺序进行选拔,最低轴距分离,只有在剩下的正积分切片太少,无法填充Top-K Set的情况下才放松. 每个结果包括分数,一个窗口的CT PNG,以及一个辐射导向的轮廓覆盖.

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows one returned overlay. Its colour-coded contours, case identifier, axial index, score, and legend make the selected evidence and its ranking inspectable alongside the companion raw CT image.Structured measurements derived from the same masks—volumes, diameters, and distances—are displayed beside the image rather than embedded in the overlay, so the user can review the numerical evidence and its visual basis side by side without obstructing the underlying anatomy.

blocks.en: 5.4 Interactive Segmentation Correction Skill
blocks.zh: 5.4 交互分区校正技能

blocks.en: To keep segmentation changes reviewable and explicitly authorized, segmentation_modification edits a case mask in a working session before any file is replaced (Figure 5 ). The editor supports slice and structure selection, positive and negative point prompts, single-slice refinement, undo, and explicit saving. Optional MedSAM2 propagation can extend accepted edits to a bounded range of adjacent slices ( Ma et al. 2025 ) . Until the user saves, other skills continue to read the original mask. Saving preserves the affine, writes the edited mask under the selected structure name, and creates a .bak copy of the previous file so that later skill calls can use the confirmed correction.
blocks.zh: 为了保持可审查且明确授权的分区更改,分区_修改在替换任何文件之前在工作会话中编辑一个大小写掩码(图5 ). 编辑器支持切片和结构选择,正点和负点提示,单片细化,取消,以及明确的保存. 可选的MDSAM2传播可以将接受的编辑扩展至一定范围的相邻切片(Ma等人,2025年)。 在用户保存之前,其他技能继续读取原口罩. 保存保存affine,将编辑过的面具写在选定的结构名称下,并创建上一个文件的.bak副本,以便以后的技巧呼叫可以使用确认的校正.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Case-specific editor for interactive segmentation correction, showing the selected structure mask overlaid on an axial slice and the controls (slice navigation, structure selection, positive/negative point prompts, view transformation, single-slice refinement, bounded 3D propagation, undo, and save). The displayed mask remains a working result until the user saves it.

blocks.en: 5.5 Three-Dimensional Reconstruction and Interactive Visualization Skill
blocks.zh: 5.5 三维重建和互动视觉技能

blocks.en: To place anatomy and resection proposals in one reviewable frame, three_d_reconstruction first builds a self-contained scene from the case masks and then overlays editable Bézier surfaces when planning is requested.
blocks.zh: 要将解剖和重新剖析的建议放在一个可审查的框架里,3_d_重建首先从病例口罩中构建一个自成一体的场景,然后在请求规划时覆盖可编辑的贝塞尔表面.

blocks.en: Three-Dimensional Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 三维 重建

blocks.en: The reconstruction supports interactive evidence review by placing liver, tumors, and vessels in a shared Three.js coordinate frame (Figure 6 ). Users can adjust visibility, navigate the anatomy, inspect mask-derived volumes, and create interactive distance measurements or annotations in the scene. The viewer also supports screenshot capture and free-form annotations directly on the 3D scene, allowing users to record observations or flag suspicious regions for later discussion. Marching Cubes ( Lorensen and Cline 1987 ) extracts each available mask surface, and the case affine maps its vertices from voxel to world coordinates. Optional Laplacian smoothing reduces staircase artefacts. The liver, tumor, portal-vein, and hepatic-vein meshes retain structure labels, colours, mask-derived volumes, and share a common scene-centering offset. Applying that offset to anatomy and later resection surfaces preserves their relative positions, while configurable sampling and downsampling balance mesh detail against browser cost.
blocks.zh: 重建通过将肝脏、肿瘤和血管置于一个共享的3.js坐标框架(图6),支持互动证据审查。 用户可以调整可见度,导航解剖,检查蒙面衍生的卷,并在场景中创建交互式距离测量或说明. 查看器还支持截图捕捉和直接在3D场景上的免费形式说明,允许用户记录观察或标出可疑区域,供日后讨论. Marching Cubes (Lorensen and Cline 1987) 提取每个可用的面具表面,该案例的afine将其顶点从voxel映射到世界坐标. 可选的Laplacian平滑会减少楼梯的手工艺品. 肝脏、肿瘤、门户、肝脏、肝脏保留结构标签、颜色、口罩产生的体积,并共享共同的场景中心抵消。 将这个抵消到解剖学和后来的重新剖面中可以保持其相对位置,而可配置的采样和下取样可以平衡网格细节与浏览器成本。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Interactive 3D reconstruction built from the case masks, showing the semi-transparent liver, tumor, portal vein, and hepatic vein in a shared coordinate frame, with structure toggles, navigation, distance measurement, annotation, and mask-derived volumes.
blocks.zh: 图6:由病例口罩构建的互动3D重建,在共享坐标框中显示半透明的肝脏,肿瘤,门户静脉和肝脏静脉,并带有结构切换,导航,距离测量,注释,以及口罩产生的容积.

blocks.en: Bézier Resection Surface Editing
blocks.zh: Bezier 重新剖析表面编辑

blocks.en: When resection planning is requested, the candidate resection surfaces from Section 6 are added to the reconstructed scene so that their spatial relationship to the tumor and vascular anatomy remains explicit. The interface provides per-candidate visibility controls, maps displayed-vertex colour to sampled nearest-tumor distance, and exposes the 4 × 4 4\times 4 control grid for editing.
blocks.zh: 当要求重新剖析规划时,在重建的场景中加入来自第6节的候选重新剖析表面,使其与肿瘤和血管解剖的空间关系保持清晰. 该接口提供每个扫描可见度控制,映射显示-顶点颜色以取样最近的-图摩距离,并曝光4×4 4\times 4控制网格进行编辑.

blocks.en: 6 Resection Planning
blocks.zh: 6 重新分类规划

blocks.en: To support preoperative review, VoxelSage uses the three-dimensional positions of the tumor, liver, and nearby vessels to generate three diverse candidate resection surfaces. The user can select a candidate and reshape it through a 4 × 4 4\times 4 control grid before saving it. The system then plans an order for moving an ultrasonic-dissector proxy across the confirmed surface. To reduce unnecessary travel and the simulated blood-loss proxy, we train a learned target-ordering model with a simulator-rollout shield. On the frozen 256-scene simulator set, the learned controller reduced mean simulated completion time from 34.274 34.274 to 33.388 33.388 min ( 2.6 % 2.6\% ) and mean simulated blood from 300.847 300.847 to 183.852 183.852 mL ( 38.9 % 38.9\% ) relative to the serpentine baseline.
blocks.zh: 为了支持手术前的审查,VoxelSage利用肿瘤,肝脏和附近血管的三维位置生成三个不同的候选剖面. 用户可以在保存前通过4×4 4\times 4控制网格选择一个候选并重塑它. 系统随后计划命令将超音速-分流代用物移动到确认的表面. 为了减少不必要的旅行和模拟失血代用品,我们用模拟器-滚出屏蔽来训练一个学习过的目标订购模型. 在冷冻的256场场景模拟器组上,学习的控制器将平均模拟完成时间从34.274 34.274分钟减少到33.388 33.388分钟(2.6% 2.6%),将模拟血液从300.847 300.847升减少到183.852 183.852毫升(38.9% 38.9%%)与蛇纹基线相比.

blocks.en: 6.1 Resection Surface Representation

blocks.en: The planner generates candidate Bézier surfaces from tumor–liver geometry and several orientations informed by liver and vessel shape. It screens them for tumor coverage, resection extent, detachable-liver support, and vessel exposure, then refines a diverse shortlist toward the configured tumor-margin constraint. The highest-ranked admissible refined surface becomes the primary recommendation.
blocks.zh: 计划者从肿瘤-肝几何和肝脏和血管形状的几种方向产生候选的贝塞尔表面。 它筛选肿瘤的覆盖范围,重新剖析范围,可切除的肝脏支持,以及容器接触,然后细化一个多样化的短名单,以适应肿瘤-边际限制。 排名最高的可接受改进表面成为主要建议。

blocks.en: Two additional surfaces are selected from the unrefined bank to provide different target resection ratios for review. They bypass the primary margin-refinement and case-mode gates and are marked for separate inspection. If no refined surface passes the case-specific gate, the system shows a coverage-qualified fallback with an explicit review flag. These selection rules are engineering heuristics, not clinically validated surgical criteria.
blocks.zh: 从未精炼的库中另外选取两个表面,以提供不同的目标重新剖析比率供审查. 它们绕过主差值精炼门和大小写码门,并标有单独的检查标记. 如果没有精细的表面通过具体案件的大门,系统就显示具有覆盖资格的回落,并带有明确的审查旗帜。 这些选择规则是工程heuristic,而不是临床验证的手术标准.

blocks.en: 6.4 Sequential Surface-Coverage Planning with Learned Ordering
blocks.zh: 6.4 连续的地表覆盖规划与学习订单

blocks.en: After the user saves an edited surface, the planner maps its 4 × 4 4\times 4 control grid back to CT coordinates and divides the liver–surface intersection into approximately 4 ​ mm 4\,\mathrm{mm} cells. The planning task is to order these cells for step-wise coverage by an ultrasonic-dissector proxy. A serpentine scan provides the baseline. Our learned mode keeps the same grid, movement rules, and start condition but learns which eligible frontier target should be visited next; deterministic shortest-path transfer handles movement between targets.
blocks.zh: 在用户保存经编辑的表面后,规划者将其4×4 4\times 4控制网格映射回CT坐标,并将肝脏–表面交叉点划分为大约4mm 4\,\mathrm{mm}细胞. 计划的任务是通过超音速-分部门代用命令这些细胞进行分步覆盖. 蛇纹扫描提供了基线. 我们的学习模式保持相同的网格、移动规则和启动条件,但了解下一步应访问哪些符合条件的前沿目标;确定性最短路径转移控制在目标之间移动。

blocks.en: For training and evaluation, the confirmed surface is represented in a reproducible two-dimensional simulator. Vessel cross-sections are retained as separate components: each remains hidden until the surrounding tissue ring has been cut, is then exposed, and is sealed when the path enters it; a boundary component follows the same transition but may be released early if it blocks every remaining non-vessel frontier cell. This preserves a complete coverage path without treating a boundary vessel as ordinary tissue.
blocks.zh: 对于训练和评价,确认的表面用可复制的二维模拟器表示. 船只横截面作为单独的部件保留:在周围组织环被切断之前,每个部分都隐藏起来,然后暴露,并在路径进入时被密封;一个边界部件遵循同样的过渡,但如果它阻断所有剩余的非流体前沿细胞,则可提前释放。 这保留了完整的覆盖路径,而不将边界容器视为普通组织。

blocks.en: The learned model ranks a small set of candidate targets, and a simulator-rollout shield checks them in that order before execution. The first candidate that can complete coverage without exceeding the frozen simulated-blood budget is accepted. Thus, the model changes target order only; the simulator controls travel, clamp timing, exposure, and sealing. Figure 8 summarizes training and shielded execution. The simulator omits vessel branching, deformation, perfusion territories, instrument reachability, cutting dynamics, intra-operative registration, and physiological response, so the resulting sequence is a controlled planning proxy rather than a surgical trajectory.
blocks.zh: 学习的模型将一组小的候选目标排序,一个模拟-推出的盾牌在执行前按此顺序对其进行检查. 第一个可以在不超过冷冻模拟血液预算的情况下完成覆盖的候选人被接受. 因此,模型只改变目标顺序;模拟器控制旅行、夹时、接触和密封。 图8总结了培训和受保护的执行。 模拟器省略了容器的分支,变形,输液区域,仪器可达性,切割动力学,操作内注册,以及生理反应,因此产生的序列是可控的规划代用,而不是手术轨迹.

blocks.en: 7 System Demonstration and Functional Verification
blocks.zh: 7 系统演示和功能核查

blocks.en: This chapter evaluates VoxelSage at three complementary levels. Section 7.1 verifies Port B coordinate handling, skill integration, three-dimensional-to-planar transfer, and fail-closed behaviour through synthetic phantoms, public CT cases, and constructed surfaces. Section 7.2 measures the learned controller against frozen comparators in the independent planar simulator, including shield ablation, latency, and condition sensitivity. Section 7.3 evaluates whether Port A can interpret requests, invoke the appropriate skills, preserve evidence faithfulness, manage multiple cases, and reuse cached results. Because these streams test different claims, their results are interpreted separately.
blocks.zh: 本章评价VoxelSage在三个互补层面. 第7.1节 核查 端口 B协调处理,技能集成,三维对平面转移,通过合成幽灵,公共CT案例,以及构建的表面,进行故障闭塞行为. 第7.2节针对独立平面模拟器中被冻结的参照器,包括屏蔽延缓、延缓和条件敏感性,衡量已学习的对照器。 第7.3节评价港口是否 一个可以解释请求,引用适当的技能,保持证据的忠实,管理多个案件,再利用缓存结果. 因为这些流测试不同的说法,它们的结果被分别解释.

blocks.en: The online evaluation proceeds through four stages: 1. verification of physical-coordinate correctness using synthetic NIfTI phantoms; 2. case preparation and execution of all eight built-in Port B skills on three public cases; 3. learned-controller transfer between a confirmed surface and the frozen planar canvas (3D → \rightarrow 2D); 4. evaluation of fail-closed and state-invalidation behavior. This organization separates numerical correctness, workflow coverage, learned bridging, and defensive behavior instead of treating them as one undifferentiated demonstration.

The physical-coordinate stage uses only synthetic non-medical data. The case-based functional and defensive checks use NIfTI conversions and released reference masks from the TCIA Colorectal-Liver-Metastases Version 2 collection, which contains preoperative CT, DICOM segmentations, and clinical data for 197 subjects under CC BY 4.0 ( Simpson et al. 2023 ; Clark et al. 2013 ) .
Reference masks isolate the downstream integration tests from segmentation error: variability in VISTA3D inference could otherwise make a failed measurement, reconstruction, or planning path ambiguous. VISTA3D’s segmentation performance and automatic and prompt-guided operating modes were evaluated in its original study ( He et al. 2025 ) ; because the present contribution is system integration rather than a segmentation model, we do not repeat that model-level validation. The three prespecified public cases used for the evaluation are CRLM-CT-1007, CRLM-CT-1012, and CRLM-CT-1036.

blocks.en: Stage 3: Learned-Controller Transfer
blocks.zh: 第3阶段:总结经验主计长 转让

blocks.en: The current core-only adapter was checked on constructed surfaces with no vessel, an internal vessel, a boundary-vessel barrier, and disconnected target regions. On identical inputs, lazy and complete candidate verification produced identical macro-action hashes, replayed paths, coverage, simulated time and blood, budgets, and intervention counts. Three additional constructed surfaces were each run twice through the public skill entry point, checking dynamic loading, saved-surface input, vessel retention, complete-grid mapping, and deterministic output.

blocks.en: The archived three-case bridge used support-expanded targets and is not counted as validation of the current core-only adapter. Its retained artifacts do not identify all core/support cells needed for an exact replay; validation on patient-derived core-only surfaces therefore remains outstanding. The constructed checks establish implementation compatibility only. Controller time and simulated-blood effects are evaluated separately on the independent 256-scene planar set in Section 7.2 .

blocks.en: Stage 4: Fail-Closed and State-Invalidation Behavior
blocks.zh: 第4阶段:关闭失败和国家认证行为

blocks.en: Nine prespecified defensive checks all met their expected outcomes. Missing or invalidated surfaces, missing or hash-mismatched checkpoints, non-frozen cell size, incompatible grid override, and illegal start cell produced visible structured rejection. When we deliberately disconnected the surface, the planner marked the result as partial instead of incorrectly reporting complete coverage. Separately, referring to the same checkpoint file through a different path did not change its identity: the system reported the same frozen hash and learned policy identifier.
blocks.zh: 九次预先规定的防御检查都达到了预期结果。 缺失或失效的表面、缺失或混杂的检查站、没有冻结的牢房大小、不兼容的网格覆盖和非法启动的牢房产生明显的结构性拒绝。 当我们故意断开表面时,规划人员将结果标为部分而不是错误地报告完全覆盖. 另外,通过不同途径提及同一检查站文件并没有改变其身份:该系统报告了相同的冻结散列和学到的政策标识。

blocks.en: Protocol and controller definitions
blocks.zh: 协议和控制器定义

blocks.en: The planar study uses synthetic two-dimensional resection-planning scenes independent of the CT demonstration. Disjoint policy-training (448), internal-development (64), tuning (64), validation (128), one-shot test (128), and stress (128) splits were frozen. Policy training alone supplied labels, gradients, and normalization scales; internal development supported teacher admission, early stopping, and the simulator-level development gate; tuning compared prespecified behaviour-cloning configurations; and validation selected the final configuration, training seed, and checkpoint. The one-shot test and subsequent stress split provided, respectively, locked in-distribution evaluation and an out-of-distribution audit, and neither informed model selection. The released five-epoch checkpoint, trained with seed 2026081603, was selected under the prespecified validation rule. Appendix Appendix B details the split roles and development gate.
blocks.zh: 平面研究采用合成二维重析规划场景,独立于CT演示. 脱节政策训练(448),内发(64),调音(64),验证(128),一发试验(128),应力(128)分解被冻结. 仅政策培训就提供了标签、梯度和正常化尺度;内部发展支持教师入学、提前停课和模拟级发展闸门;对预先确定的行为克隆配置进行比较;以及验证选定最后配置、培训种子和检查站。 单发测试和随后的压力分裂分别提供了锁定在分配中的评价和分配外的审计,以及两个知情的模型选择. 已放行的5个纪检点,经过2026081603种子训练,在预先规定的验证规则下被选中. 附 录 B详细介绍了角色分工和发展大门.

blocks.en: After checkpoint freeze, we used 32 scenes for a pilot, a newly frozen set of 256 previously unseen scenes for the main confirmation, 64 of those confirmation scenes for an isolated latency benchmark with three repetitions, and 128 base geometries per sensitivity condition. The primary endpoint is the paired time difference C4–C0; C4–C2 tests learning specificity, C3 is the full-rollout teacher reference, and C5 isolates removal of exact verification. Confidence intervals use 10,000 paired bootstrap resamples. The simulator gate requires a complete legal episode, no invariant or budget violation, a paired simulated-blood increase within M B M_{B} , and a favorable time interval excluding zero.

blocks.en: The reported experiments ran locally on a Windows 11 workstation with an Intel Core Ultra 7 255HX CPU (20 logical processors), Python 3.10.21, and PyTorch 2.5.1+cpu. The isolated latency benchmark used one scene worker, three repetitions per scene, and six leaf workers for C3; its wall times must not be pooled with results from the earlier server environment or with multi-scene throughput runs.

blocks.en: Primary replication and learning specificity
blocks.zh: 初级复制和学习特性

blocks.en: All five reported controllers completed 256/256 main-confirmation scenes with legal actions. C4 reduced mean simulated time from 34.274 to 33.388 min relative to C0, a paired difference of − 0.886 -0.886 min (95% CI [ − 0.947 , − 0.826 ] [-0.947,-0.826] ; Cohen’s d z = − 1.77 d_{z}=-1.77 ), with 252 wins, three ties, and one loss. Its mean simulated-blood difference was − 116.995 -116.995 mL (95% CI [ − 135.484 , − 99.784 ] [-135.484,-99.784] ); C4 never exceeded C0 beyond numerical tolerance and produced no episode-budget overrun.

blocks.en: C4 was 3.736 min faster than the non-learned C2 comparator (95% CI [ − 4.094 , − 3.389 ] [-4.094,-3.389] ; d z = − 1.28 d_{z}=-1.28 ), supporting learning specificity against that heuristic rather than superiority over every deterministic method. The full-rollout teacher C3 achieved a slightly shorter simulated episode time: 33.178 min versus 33.388 min for C4, a mean C4–C3 difference of + 0.210 +0.210 min. C4 nevertheless retained 80.9% of the teacher’s improvement over C0 while avoiding C3’s need to evaluate all candidates. Figure 9 summarizes controller-level paired effects on simulated time and blood relative to C0.

blocks.en: Shield ablation and computational cost
blocks.zh: 盾牌膨胀和计算费用

blocks.en: The unshielded C5 controller exceeded its episode budget in 24/256 scenes, compared with 0/256 for C4. The lazy exact shield changed the top-ranked choice in only 92/97,320 macro actions (0.0945%), yet those sparse interventions removed the observed nominal-set overruns. Figure 10 shows the paired simulated-blood differences from C0; values above the frozen margin correspond to episode-budget overruns.
blocks.zh: 无屏蔽的C5控制器在24/256场景中超过了它的插曲预算,而C4则比0.256. 懒惰的精确盾牌只改变了92/97,320项宏观行动(0.0945%)中排在前列的选择,然而这些稀少的干预却消除了所观察到的名义设定超支。 图10显示了与C0的对称模拟血缘差异;高于冻结边距的值与插曲预算超支相对应.

blocks.en: In the isolated local CPU benchmark (64 scenes, three repetitions), each scene was first summarized by its median across repetitions. Across these 64 scene medians, C4 had median, mean, and 95th-percentile episode wall times of 21.21, 27.69, and 65.10 s. C3, with six leaf workers, required 46.85, 74.43, and 267.02 s, respectively. Thus, C4’s median planning time was 54.7% lower, or approximately 2.21 × 2.21\times faster, than C3. This comparison measures controller computation rather than simulated surgical time: C3 still produced episodes that were 0.210 simulated minutes shorter on average, whereas C4 provided the intended latency–quality compromise. C5 omits exact verification and therefore represents the less constrained ablation, not the primary controller.
blocks.zh: 在孤立的本地CPU基准(64场,3场重复)中,每个场景首先以其跨重复的中位数进行总结. 在这64个场景中位数中,C4的中位数,平均数,和95个百分点的插曲壁时间分别为21.21,27.69和65.10s.C3,有6名叶工,分别需要46.85,74.43和267.02s. 因此,C4的规划时间中位数比C3低54.7%,或约2.21×2.21\时速快. 这种比较测量控制器的计算而不是模拟外科手术时间:C3仍然产生平均缩短0.210分钟的模拟事件,而C4提供了预期的耐久性-质量妥协。 C5省略了精确的校验,因此代表了限制较少的衰减,而不是主控制器.

blocks.en: Condition-specific sensitivity
blocks.zh: 特定条件的敏感性

blocks.en: C4 completed all 128 scenes under each of S0–S4 with no infeasible termination or episode-budget overrun. C5 also completed every scene, but exceeded its condition-specific budget in 14, 10, 12, 11, and 8 scenes, respectively (Table 3 ). These results support completion and budget adherence under the tested perturbations. The lower bleeding coefficients retain the same absolute margin M B M_{B} , so their relative budget allowance can be larger; they do not establish robustness under uniformly scaled relative constraints.

blocks.en: The main confirmation, learning-specificity, shield-ablation, and latency results form an internally consistent evidence chain inside the frozen simulator. The sensitivity audit confirms complete coverage without observed budget overruns across the five tested conditions using condition-specific baselines. None of these experiments validates the online three-dimensional adapter, a clinical workflow, a surgical trajectory, physiological safety, or patient-level blood loss; those distinctions motivate the separate Port B bridge and fail-closed experiments above.
blocks.zh: 主要的确认,学习的特异性,屏蔽-缩放,以及延迟的结果,形成了冷冻模拟器内部一致的证据链. 敏感性审计证实,在未观察到预算超支的情况下,利用特定条件的基线对五个测试条件进行了全面审计。 这些实验都无法验证在线三维适配器、临床工作流程、手术轨迹、生理安全或病人的失血情况;这些区别刺激了上述单独的B港桥和故障闭合实验。

blocks.en: 7.3 Port A Orchestration Evaluation

blocks.en:
While the independent evaluations of Port B in Sections 7.1 and 7.2 establish its correctness within the tested scope,
correct computation by Port B alone does not ensure users can get correct answer after entering queries, which requires the correctness of the whole workflow of our website, including both skill execution and agent orchestration. We therefore evaluate the ability of Port A, determining whether Port A can correctly interpret requests, invoke the
appropriate skills, and formulate answers from their outputs.
To assess the reliability and efficiency of this process,
we also examine whether Port A avoids unsupported findings (i.e. hallucination), keeps information associated with the correct case, and
correctly reuses available results.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: VoxelSage connects case-centered CT preparation, deterministic measurement, selected two- and three-dimensional evidence, interactive correction, and confirmation-gated planning through a dual-port agent architecture. Results remain linked to source images, masks, geometry, and execution records. The optional planning adapter uses a geometry-only conservative-core crop that retains boundary vessel proxies to map a frozen planar ranker and lazy exact simulator shield onto a confirmed surface while preserving complete-grid identifiers and fail-closed behavior. Constructed-surface tests verified the adapter and its public skill invocation; in the separate frozen simulator C4 improved time over prespecified baselines without nominal-set budget violations while reducing median controller wall time by 54.7% relative to C3. The same frozen controller completed all five sensitivity conditions without observed episode-budget overruns.
blocks.zh: VoxelSage连接了以案例为中心的CT准备,定型测量,选取的二维和三维证据,交互校正,并通过双port代理架构进行确认式规划. 结果仍然与源图像、口罩、几何和执行记录有关。 可选的规划适配器使用一种仅几何保守-核心的作物,保留边界船的代理,将一个冷冻的平板板和懒惰精确的模拟屏蔽映射到确认的表面,同时保留完整的网格识别符和故障闭塞行为. 构造式地面测试核实了适配器及其公共技能的引用;在单独的冷冻模拟器C4中,比预先规定的基线时间有所改善,没有名义上设定的预算违规,同时相对C3将中位控制器墙壁时间减少了54.7%。 同一个冷冻控制器完成了所有五个敏感条件,没有观察到插座预算超支.

blocks.en: These results establish workflow integration and a reproducible simulator experiment, rather than clinical accuracy, benefit, safety, or patient-level blood-loss prediction. The system has been evaluated only as an in-lab engineering demonstration on a small number of public cases, and its learned component was trained on two-dimensional proxy tasks rather than real surgical dynamics. Clinical utility will require external evaluation in representative cohorts and real clinical workflows, with appropriate outcome measures and uncertainty estimation.
blocks.zh: 这些结果建立了工作流程集成和可复制的模拟实验,而不是临床的准确性,收益性,安全性,或者病人一级的失血预测. 该系统仅被评价为对少数公共案例的实验室内工程演示,其学习到的组件接受了二维代用任务而非真手术动力学的培训. 临床实用性要求在具有代表性的群体和真正的临床工作流程中进行外部评价,并有适当的结果计量和不确定性估计。

blocks.en: Collectively, these skills separate case preparation and deterministic computation from orchestration and review. The measurement and evidence-generation skills are read-only and stateless, whereas the correction and planning skills introduce explicit user state—a saved mask or a saved candidate surface—that gates downstream recomputation and planning. Their shared manifest and case-context contract allows Port A to select among them without exposing unrestricted case paths or treating every capability as one monolithic pipeline.

blocks.en:
1. Package structure. A minimal package directory contains skill.yaml and main.py. The repository includes examples/skills/tumor_volume_report as a minimal example. 2. Manifest schema. The manifest must define name, version, and description; triggers, inputs, and outputs are optional. Inputs marked source: context are excluded from the language-model function schema and supplied by Port B, whereas other inputs become task parameters exposed to the model. 3. Entry point. The entry point must define run(ctx) and return a JSON-serializable dictionary. Its context exposes the case identifier and parameters together with lazy accessors for the CT array, affine, voxel spacing, available masks, mask arrays or paths, output directory, and logging. 4. Registration. The frontend skill manager accepts one .zip package, refreshes the skill list after registration, labels entries as built-in or user supplied, and exposes deletion for user entries. The registration engine requires both package files, restricts the manifest name to letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores, searches main.py for a run definition, limits each file to 2 MiB and the directory to 5 MiB, and copies the directory to skills/user/{name}. Registering the same name replaces that directory and its in-memory entry; unregistering a user skill removes the copy. 5. Execution and isolation. GET /api/skills/list exposes registered manifests in both human-readable and OpenAI-compatible function-calling forms, and POST /api/skills/run supplies the prepared case context. Built-in skills are imported into Port B, whereas a user skill runs in a child Python process.
The wrapper enforces a 120-s wall timeout and operating-system limits of 120 CPU seconds, 32 processes, and 512 open files, then accepts only a dictionary that can be serialized as JSON. These controls bound some failures but do not provide a separate operating-system identity, container, memory quota, dependency environment, or filesystem and network isolation; the child receives paths to case inputs and the output directory.

blocks.en: The learned_shielded algorithm is opt-in and does not replace the deterministic nearest, dfs, or spanning_tree modes. It requires an explicitly saved surface, approximately 4-mm cells whose cropped liver-domain window fits the frozen 30 × 40 30\times 40 canvas, and checkpoint SHA-256 c07904502d6b71a74484adb1c27971c77cdf6a61bb20b04f1f39d786d61a70be . With the default intersection threshold, the adapter retains the four-of-five sampled-liver core without adding support cells, preserves boundary vessel proxies in place, and maps the cropped adapter indices back to the complete saved-surface grid. Boundary components follow the full-ring rule except for the frontier-deadlock release described in Section 6.4 . At each macro step, the frozen ranker orders the candidates and the lazy exact shield verifies them in that order, stopping at the first candidate that completes under the frozen S-tail without failure or budget excess.
blocks.zh: 已学习的_ 屏蔽算法是选入的, 并且不会取代最接近、 dfs 或跨行的_ 树模式 。 它需要一个明确保存的表面,大约为4毫米的细胞,其收割的肝脏面积窗适合冷冻的30×40 30\的40次帆布,以及检查站SHA-256 c07904502d6b71a74484adb1c27971c77cdf6a61b20b04f1f39d786d61a70be. 在默认的交叉阈值下,适配器保留了五分之四的采样-肝核而未添加支持细胞,保留了边界容器的代位,并将裁剪后的适配器指数映射回完整保存的表面网格. 除第6.4节所述的边界-死锁释放外,边界组件遵循全环规则。 在每一个宏观步骤中,被冻结的排位者命令候选人,懒惰的精确盾牌按照这个顺序验证他们,在被冻结的S尾下完成的第一个候选人在没有失败或预算超额的情况下停下来.

blocks.en: A missing or mismatched checkpoint, incompatible cell size, out-of-envelope cropped domain, illegal start, incomplete controller rollout, absence of an admissible candidate, or simulator-budget overrun produces a structured failure rather than a deterministic fallback labelled as learned output. The controller covers the start-connected component; when other target components remain, the skill returns partial, identifies uncovered cells, and reports coverage against the complete target. Successful results distinguish three-dimensional geometry from simulator proxies by recording source and adapter grids, crop origin, core and boundary-vessel counts, mapped three-dimensional path, policy and checkpoint identifiers, intervention count, simulator time and blood quantities, runtime, and a scope warning. These fields support implementation audit, not clinical validation of the path, vessel proxy, or simulator budget.
blocks.zh: 检查点缺失或不匹配、单元格大小不兼容、信封外域、非法启动、控制器推出不完整、没有可接受候选人、或模拟-预算超支,都会产生结构性故障,而不是被贴上学习产出标签的决定性倒置。 控制器覆盖了启动连接部分;当其他目标部分保留下来时,技能返回部分,识别未发现的单元格,并报告覆盖到完全目标. 成功的结果通过记录源头和适配器网格,作物来源,核心和边界的流星计数,映射的三维路径,政策和检查站识别符,干预计数,模拟时间和血量,运行时间,以及范围警告,来区分三维几何和模拟代数. 这些字段支持执行审计,而不是临床验证路径,船代理,或模拟预算.

blocks.en: The internal development gate was a prespecified go/no-go screen applied to the teacher and then to the shielded learned controller before tuning data were opened. It required complete legal episodes, no failure or simulator-invariant violation, no per-scene excess beyond the frozen simulated-blood margin, a favourable paired time interval, and the corresponding aggregate blood criterion. For the learned controller, it additionally required retention of at least 50% of the teacher’s mean time improvement. Failure stopped the route, apart from the single DAgger round allowed after an initial learned-policy failure; passing the gate only authorized progression to tuning and did not constitute test evidence or a claim of clinical safety.
